title: API Client Library Generator
description: Create a reusable API client library with error handling, type safety, and utilities. Generates clients/ library with complete implementation including ApiClient, ApiError, hooks, and error boundary component.

name.description: Name of the client library (e.g., client, apiClient, httpClient). Creates clients/[name]/ with full library structure and exports.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this client library?

directory.description: Override the directory where the client library will be created (default: clients/ creates clients/[name]/)

orgName.description: Organization name for scoped package path (e.g., @myorg creates @myorg/[name] for package.json and imports)

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)
